INSERT INTO t SELECT 'f', bm25(ext_bm25_by_file), rpath(e.sname, e.sroll)||'/'||e.name, e.name, e.size, e.mtime, replace(replace(snippet(ext_bm25_by_file, -1, '[', ']', ' … ', 12), char(10), ' '), char(13), ' ') FROM extdb.ext_bm25_by_file JOIN vrpentries e ON CAST(binode AS INT64) = e.inode AND CAST(bmtime AS INT64) = e.mtime WHERE ext_bm25_by_file MATCH '("budget" AND "report")' ORDER BY 2, 3 LIMIT 20;

DELETE FROM t WHERE rowid IN (SELECT rowid FROM (SELECT rowid, k, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY r, p) AS rn FROM t) WHERE rn > CASE k WHEN 'n' THEN 10 WHEN 'p' THEN 10 WHEN 'f' THEN 60 ELSE 0 END); INSERT INTO t SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'n', CASE WHEN name LIKE 'budget report' OR name LIKE 'budget report.%' THEN 0 WHEN name LIKE 'budget%' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, rpath(sname, sroll)||'/'||name, name, size, mtime, '' FROM vrpentries WHERE (name LIKE '%budget%' AND name LIKE '%report%') ORDER BY 2, 3 LIMIT 10) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'p', length(substr(rpath(sname, sroll), 15)), rpath(sname, sroll)||'/'||name, name, size, mtime, '' FROM vrpentries WHERE ((substr(rpath(sname, sroll), 15) LIKE '%budget%' AND substr(rpath(sname, sroll), 15) LIKE '%report%')) AND NOT ((name LIKE '%budget%' AND name LIKE '%report%')) ORDER BY 2, 3 LIMIT 10); INSERT INTO t SELECT 'f', bm25(words), rpath(sname, sroll)||'/'||vrpentries.name, vrpentries.name, size, mtime, replace(replace(snippet(words, 2, '[', ']', ' … ', 12), char(10), ' '), char(13), ' ') FROM vrpentries INNER JOIN words ON inode=CAST(tinode AS TEXT) WHERE wordf MATCH '("budget" AND "report")' ORDER BY 2, 3 LIMIT 20;
INSERT INTO agg SELECT * FROM t;

WITH best AS (SELECT k, min(r) AS r, p, n, s, m, x FROM agg GROUP BY k, p), ranked AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY r, p) AS rn FROM best), kept AS (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn <= CASE k WHEN 'n' THEN 10 WHEN 'p' THEN 10 WHEN 'f' THEN 60 ELSE 0 END), fused AS (SELECT p AS fp, sum(1.0 / (60.0 + rn)) AS score FROM kept GROUP BY p) SELECT k, r, p, n, s, m, x FROM kept JOIN fused ON p = fp ORDER BY score DESC, p, k;

WITH best AS (SELECT k, min(r) AS r, p, n, s, m, x FROM agg GROUP BY k, p), ranked AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY r, p) AS rn FROM best), kept AS (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn <= CASE k WHEN 'n' THEN 10 WHEN 'p' THEN 10 WHEN 'f' THEN 60 ELSE 10 END), fused AS (SELECT p AS fp, sum(1.0 / (60.0 + rn)) AS score FROM kept GROUP BY p) SELECT k, r, p, n, s, m, x FROM kept JOIN fused ON p = fp ORDER BY score DESC, p, k;
